enchantments.tooltip: +9 Enhancement Bonus: +9 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Poisonous 4: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to drip with a vile venom, dealing 4d6 poison damage on each hit.
Disintegration: This weapon has a dark, insidious power deep within. Occasionally, this power lashes out violently at enemies and attempts to disintegrate them.
Fortitude Save +9: This item gives a +9 Resistance bonus to your Fortitude saves.

Large Scorpion Poison: On a critical hit, this weapon injects the target with Large Scorpion poison, causing 1 to 4 Constitution loss with an additional 1 to 4 Constitution loss after 1 minute if a DC 14 Fortitude save is failed.
Returning: This missile will return to you.
